author: 小小单词卡
attribution: PET 口袋绘本系列原创短篇 · 第三篇
intro: 两件一模一样的大衣，两张收据。梅得把大衣还对人，还得替一位爸爸保住生日礼物的秘密。

chapters.title: 谁抓住了袖子？
chapters.en: The [[concert]] was over. As the [[music]] faded, a [[customer]] reached for his coat. May’s neighbour was holding the same [[sleeve]].
chapters.zh: 音乐会散场，音乐声渐渐消失。一位顾客伸手去拿大衣，梅的邻居正抓着同一只袖子。

chapters.title: 两件一模一样的大衣
chapters.en: May found a second [[coat]]. Both were made of [[wool]]. She checked the [[label]] inside each one. Even the [[size]] was the same.
chapters.zh: 梅又找到一件大衣。两件都是羊毛做的。她翻看衣服里面的标签，连尺码也一样。

chapters.title: 口袋里藏着什么？
chapters.en: The [[shop assistant]] pointed to the pockets. May found a [[receipt]] in each. The man hugged his [[parcel]]. Inside was a present for his daughter’s [[birthday]].
chapters.zh: 店员指了指衣袋。梅从两个口袋里各翻出一张收据。男人抱紧包裹，里面是给女儿的生日礼物。

chapters.title: 十二英镑能看出什么？
chapters.en: The [[date]] on both receipts was the same. Both gifts [[cost]] twelve pounds. The man paid in [[cash]]. He gave twenty pounds and got eight pounds in [[change]].
chapters.zh: 两张收据上的日期相同。两件礼物都花了十二英镑。男人用现金付了二十英镑，找回八英镑。

chapters.title: 是谁的大衣？
chapters.en: May’s neighbour opened her [[purse]] and showed her [[credit card]]. Now May could [[return]] the other coat to the man. His parcel went BOOM. His daughter knew which [[instrument]] was inside!
chapters.zh: 邻居打开小钱包，亮出信用卡。梅终于能把另一件大衣还给男人了。包裹咚地响了一声，女儿猜到了里面是哪种乐器！

album.en: After a [[concert]] in the [[music]] shop, May's [[neighbour]] reached for her [[coat]]. Another [[customer]] caught the same [[sleeve]]. “Hang on,” he said. “I think that's mine.”
album.zh: 乐器店里的音乐会散场了。梅的邻居伸手去拿大衣，另一位顾客也抓住了那只袖子。“等等，”他说，“这件好像是我的。”

album.en: The [[shop assistant]] lifted a second [[coat]] off the hook. Same thick [[wool]]. Same big buttons. May checked the [[label]] inside each one. Even the [[size]] was the same.
album.zh: 店员从挂钩上取下第二件大衣。一样厚实的羊毛，一样的大纽扣。梅看了看两件衣服里面的标签，连尺码都一样。

album.en: In each [[pocket]] May found a [[receipt]]. The man hugged his [[parcel]]. “Mine says what I bought for my daughter's [[birthday]],” he whispered. Behind him, a little girl stood on tiptoe.
album.zh: 梅在两个口袋里各找到一张收据。男人抱紧包裹，小声说：“我的那张上写着我给女儿买的生日礼物。”他身后，一个小女孩正踮着脚尖看。

album.en: May kept each slip on its [[coat]] and hid the names of the items with her train [[ticket]]. Same [[date]]. Same [[price]]. Both items [[cost]] twelve pounds. Now what?
album.zh: 梅把两张收据各留在各自的大衣上，再用火车票遮住商品名。日期相同，价钱也一样。两样东西都花了十二英镑。这下怎么办？

album.en: “[[Cash]] or [[credit card]]?” May asked. Her [[neighbour]] pulled a card from her [[purse]]. “I gave them twenty pounds,” said the man. Only one [[receipt]] showed eight pounds in [[change]].
album.zh: “付现金还是刷信用卡？”梅问。邻居从钱包里抽出卡。男人说：“我给了他们二十英镑。”只有一张收据上写着找零八英镑。

album.en: May picked up the [[coat]] with the [[cash]] [[receipt]] to [[return]] it to the man. His [[parcel]] bumped the door. BOOM! “I know which [[instrument]] you bought!” His daughter drummed on her knees.
album.zh: 梅拿起装着现金小票的那件大衣，递还给那位爸爸。他手里的包裹碰到了门。咚！“我知道你买的是什么乐器啦！”女儿说着，用两只手在膝盖上敲起鼓来。
